question: What factors depends on the apparent volume of distribution of a drug ?:

options.opa: Its degree of binding to plasma and tissue proteins and its elimination half-life.
options.opb: Of its distribution coefficient and its elimination half-life.
options.opc: Of its elimination half-life and its elimination constant.
options.opd: Its degree of binding to plasma and tissue proteins and their distribution coefficient.
options.ope: Of its constant elimination and its clearing.
